usage.text:
Usage: ot [options] Commands: daemon Start the OTheater daemon in this terminal backup Make a backup of the data now restore Put a backup back (the daemon must be stopped) directives [...] Orders (the daemon must be stopped); actions: list, show , add , extend , suspend --scenario [text], revoke --reason chat Talk to the Director of a repository (the daemon must be running) tui Open the terminal interface (the daemon must be running) profile [...] Accounts of the clients (the daemon must be stopped); actions: add , list, drain /, remove /, exec / [-- ] (also with the daemon running), shims sync, shims path [--install|--uninstall] (the commands by profile) executor [...] Executors of the models (the daemon must be stopped); actions: models , add , list, check [id], remove api rotate-token Swap the API token (works with the daemon stopped or running) trajectory export Write the ATIF trajectory of a play to a file (works with the daemon stopped or running) Options: --data-dir Data directory (default: OT_DATA_DIR, else the user data folder) -h, --help Show this help -v, --version Show the version Options of "ot directives": --scenario Local order for this scenario (without it, add makes a global one) --kind instruction (default), rule or suspension --role Only for this role (repeat it for more roles) --rule-key --rule-value The configuration key a rule overrides, and its value --suspends The global order a suspension takes out of the scenario --replaces Revoke this order and put the new one in its place --from --until --for Validity (YYYY-MM-DD [HH:mm]; 30m, 2h, 3d) --forever extend: take the end away --reason revoke: why --all list: also expired and revoked orders Options of "ot chat": --repo The repository (default: the current folder) --base The branch plays start from and deliver to (default: main) --name A name for the scenario (default: the folder name; a chat is identified by it) --type project (default, needs a repository) or chat (a generic chat, no repository) --new-project Create the project in --repo (a folder that does not exist or is empty) with the structure of the software profile Options of "ot profile": --kind add: token_plan (default, a subscription) or api (a key) --provider

add: the provider of the account (default: anthropic for claude-code, openai for codex) --api-key-env add --kind api: the NAME of the environment variable that holds the key (never type the key as an argument) --api-key-stdin add --kind api: read the key from the first line of the standard input --accept-notice add: go on after the notice about a second subscription account of the same provider --client list: only this client --all list: also the removed profiles --check-login list: ask each client whether the profile has a login --json Print JSON instead of text exec runs the client's own CLI inside the profile, in this terminal. The common words login, logout, status, run and --model (and those of profiles.commands and profiles.options) become the client's own; after "--" the arguments go as they are. shims sync writes one command per profile (codex-personal) in the bin folder of the data; shims path says how to put that folder in PATH: --install / --uninstall shims path: write or take out the line in the rc file of the shell (asks first) --shell shims path: zsh, bash or fish (default: the one of SHELL) -y, --yes shims path --install: do not ask Options of "ot executor": --effort add: low, medium or high (default: what the catalog suggests) --family add: the family (provider) of a model whose catalog gives none --as add: the name of the model inside the Executor id (default: derived) --local-url add: URL of the local model server (default: the one in the catalog) --local-server add: llama-cpp (default) or ollama --role [:] add: also put it in this role, at position n (repeat it for more roles) --test-session add: run the short test session (it calls the model); --no-test-session skips it --dry-run add: report the fields and the checks, write nothing --profile list: only the Executors of this profile --all list: also the removed ones Options of "ot trajectory": --unit play (one file, the attempts embedded), attempt (one file per attempt) or play_files (the play and one file per attempt); default: atif.export.unit (with the daemon running, only play) --content full (default: atif.export.content; the secrets are masked all the same) or redacted (no text) --out

The folder of the files (default: atif.export.dir, "trajectories" in the data folder) In the chat, "/attach " attaches a file (copied; "/attach --ref " keeps it in place): the next message you send names it as A for the Director. Without a command, "ot" opens the terminal interface when the input and the output are a terminal (ui.bare_command: tui, the default); with ui.bare_command: help, or without a terminal, it shows this help. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 the command failed, 2 wrong usage.
usage.missingBackupPath: "ot restore" needs the backup folder to restore.
usage.noInput: "ot chat" needs a place to read the messages from.
usage.tuiNeedsTerminal: "ot tui" needs a terminal: the input and the output must be a terminal.
usage.tuiNotBuilt: The terminal interface is not built: run "pnpm build" (missing: {{file}}).
usage.missingDirectivesAction: "ot directives" needs an action: list, show, add, extend, suspend or revoke.
usage.directiveNeedsId: This action needs the order id (for example O1).
usage.directiveNeedsText: "ot directives add" needs the text of the order.
usage.directiveNeedsScenario: "ot directives suspend" needs --scenario <id>: the scenario that stops following the order.
usage.directiveKind: --kind must be instruction, rule or suspension.
usage.directiveTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot directives".
usage.missingProfileAction: "ot profile" needs an action: add, list, drain, remove or exec.
usage.profileTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot profile".
usage.profileNeedsClientName: "ot profile add" needs the client and the profile name (for example: claude-code work).
usage.profileNeedsProvider: "ot profile add" needs --provider <provider> for this client.
usage.profileApiNeedsKey: An API profile needs the key: --api-key-env <NAME> or --api-key-stdin.
usage.profileNoInput: "ot profile add --api-key-stdin" needs a place to read the key from.
usage.profileNeedsId: This action needs the profile id (<client>/<name>, for example claude-code/work).
usage.missingExecutorAction: "ot executor" needs an action: models, add, list, check or remove.
usage.executorTooMany: Too many arguments for this action of "ot executor".
usage.executorNeedsProfile: "ot executor models" needs the profile id (<client>/<name>, for example opencode/local).
usage.executorNeedsModel: "ot executor add" needs the profile id and the model (for example: opencode/local minimax/MiniMax-M2).
usage.executorNeedsId: This action needs the Executor id (<model>-<effort>@<client>/<profile>).
usage.profileExecId: "{{id}}" is not a profile id (<client>/<name>, for example codex/personal).
usage.profileExecMissingValue: The common option --{{name}} needs a value.
usage.profileExecNotForClient: "{{word}}" is a common word that {{client}} has no translation for. Its common commands: {{commands}}; its common options: {{options}}. To give the word to the client as it is, put it after "--".
usage.missingShimsAction: "ot profile shims" needs an action: sync or path.
usage.unknownShimsAction: Unknown action "{{action}}" for "ot profile shims" (sync or path).
usage.shimsPathOnly: --install, --uninstall and --shell are options of "ot profile shims path".
usage.shimsNeedShell: Could not tell the shell from SHELL; say which with --shell ({{shells}}).
usage.missingTrajectoryAction: Missing action for "ot trajectory". Use: export <play>.
usage.unknownTrajectoryAction: Unknown action for "ot trajectory": {{action}}. Use: export <play>.
usage.trajectoryNeedsPlay: "ot trajectory {{action}}" needs the id of a play.
usage.trajectoryTooMany: "ot trajectory export" takes only one play.

daemon.running: OTheater daemon running (pid {{pid}}), data in {{dataDir}}. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
daemon.vaultLocked: The vault is locked: no master password was given, so secrets are not available.

backup.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory: the copy is made from the database file and no event is recorded.

restore.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it before restoring.
restore.keptDatabase: The previous database was kept as {{path}}.
restore.keptScenarios: The previous scenarios folder was kept as {{path}}.
restore.daemonIdRestored: The daemon id of the backup was restored.
restore.keptDaemonId: The previous daemon id file was kept as {{path}}.

api.rotatedOffline: New API token written to the api-token file. The daemon is stopped, so it will be used at the next start.
api.rotated: API token swapped. The old token no longer works; the new one is in the api-token file.
api.noApi: The daemon is running on this data directory, but its API is off or its api.json is stale. Check "ot daemon" and try again.
api.noToken: The api-token file is missing or cannot be read, so the daemon cannot be asked to swap it.
api.unreachable: Could not reach the daemon API at {{url}}.
api.rejected: The daemon refused the request (HTTP {{status}}). The api-token file may be old: check that it belongs to this daemon.
api.failed: The daemon could not swap the token (HTTP {{status}}).

trajectory.needsStoppedDaemon: The daemon is running on this data directory: only the unit "play" (one file with every attempt embedded) can be exported now. Stop the daemon for "attempt" or "play_files".
trajectory.noToken: The api-token file is missing or cannot be read, so the daemon cannot be asked for the trajectory.
trajectory.failedOnline: The daemon could not give the trajectory (HTTP {{status}}).

chat.noDaemon: No daemon is running on this data directory (or it is not reachable). Start it with "ot daemon".
chat.opened: Chat open on scenario {{scenarioId}}. Type a message and press Enter.

generatedReply.none: System: the Director ended the turn without a reply.
generatedReply.tools: System: the Director ended the turn without a reply. Tools called: {{tools}}.{{play}}

shellEnded.timeout: Command stopped after {{seconds}} s (time limit); its processes were ended.

shellCut.tail: ... only the last {{shown}} of {{total}} lines are shown; the whole output is in the log.
shellCut.head: ... only the first {{shown}} of {{total}} lines are shown; the whole output is in the log.

chat.shellAskedInput: The command asked for input, but a ! command has no keyboard: it got the end of the input and ended.
chat.shellContextAsked: The Director was not told yet: a question waits for your answer.
chat.waitingFor_budget: waiting for the spending cap of {{profiles}}
chat.waitingFor_no_slot: waiting for a free slot on {{profiles}}
chat.menu:
Play {{playId}} needs you: {{reason}}
Type one of: {{options}} (after redefine_need, the new need; after the others, an optional reason).
chat.question: The Director asks: {{question}}
chat.badOption: That is not one of the options. Type one of: {{options}}.
chat.askWithdrawn: The question was answered somewhere else, so it was taken back.
chat.reconnecting: The connection to the daemon dropped ({{message}}). Trying again in {{seconds}} s.
chat.connectionLost: The connection to the daemon was lost: {{message}}
chat.leftPending: Something still waits for your answer. It stays in the daemon: run "ot chat" again to answer it.
chat.attached: Attached as {{id}}: {{name}} ({{mime}}, {{size}} bytes). It goes with your next message.
chat.ideaUsage: Usage: /idea [--area <area>] <text> | /idea list | /idea drain | /idea discard <id> <reason> | /idea defer <id> <reason> | /idea requeue <id>
chat.ideaHeld:
The idea queue stopped: {{what}} ({{reason}}).
  It stays stopped until you type /idea drain, /idea requeue <id> or add a new idea.
chat.ideaHeldWhat_author_failed: the Author could not group the ideas
chat.ideaHeldWhat_author_left_all_out: the Author left every idea out of the group
chat.ideaHeldWhat_play_not_opened: the play of the group did not open
chat.ideaHeldWhat_play_ended: the play of the group ended without delivering (play {{playId}})
chat.ideaGroupOptions: Type: approve | edit <new need> | keep <ids in order> | refuse [reason].
chat.ideaGroupBad: That is not one of the options. Type: approve, edit <new need>, keep <ids> or refuse [reason].

system.handoff: System: attempt {{attemptId}} passed the baton from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{cause}}); the work goes on from the saved state.
system.selectionWait: System: the {{role}} waits for an Executor that is not of the same {{what}} as the work ({{crossCheck}}); nothing else is available: {{on}}. It goes on by itself when one is.
system.resetWait: System: attempt {{attemptId}} waits for {{what}} of {{executor}} to come back, until {{until}}; it resumes the same conversation by itself.
system.resetWaitNoDate: System: attempt {{attemptId}} waits for {{what}} of {{executor}} to come back; it resumes the same conversation by itself.

directorFailover.switched: System: the Director's session of {{from}} failed ({{cause}}); a new session opened with {{to}}, with the state summary, and the prompt in progress went back to the queue.
directorFailover.waiting: System: the Director's session of {{from}} failed ({{cause}}) and no Executor is available; the queue waits and the Director goes on by itself when one is free{{until}}.
directorFailover.unavailable: System: the Director's session of {{from}} failed ({{cause}}) and no other Executor can take it; the queue is held until the next prompt tries again.

recovery.title: System: the daemon restarted and reconciled this scenario.

directives.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it to change orders here, or ask the Director to propose the change.

profile.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it before changing profiles (the live control of a running daemon is not built yet).
profile.keyEnvEmpty: The environment variable {{name}} is empty or not set; no key to store.
profile.keyStdinEmpty: The standard input has no key on its first line.
profile.needsNotice: Another subscription account of {{provider}} is already registered ({{existing}}). OTheater does not check whether the terms of the provider allow more than one subscription account: read them before going on. Nothing was made. To register this profile anyway, run the command again with --accept-notice.
profile.noticeAccepted: Notice accepted and recorded: another subscription account of {{provider}} exists ({{existing}}).
profile.addedKey: The key is in the vault ({{backend}}); it is given only to the processes of this profile.
profile.addedLogin: Login: {{state}}. If it is not logged in, log in with the client itself, using this profile's folder.
profile.drained_finished: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; nothing was running.
profile.drained_handoff: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; {{sessions}} session(s) went back to the queue.
profile.drained_forced: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; {{sessions}} session(s) were stopped.
profile.drained_still_running: Profile {{id}} is draining: no new session; {{sessions}} session(s) are still running.
profile.dir_backup: Its folder was moved to the backup folder (profiles.drain.removed_dir: keep_backup).
profile.secretDeleted: The key was removed from the vault.
profile.execRemoved: Profile {{id}} was removed; its client cannot run in it.
profile.execNoClient: There is no adapter for the client {{client}} here (not found in PATH, or not a known client).
profile.execNoProfileCli: The adapter of {{client}} cannot run its CLI inside a profile.
profile.execDraining: Profile {{id}} is draining: the daemon gives it no new work, but this command runs.
profile.shimsConflict: No command {{name}}: another program already has that name in PATH ({{at}}). Set profiles.shims.prefix to use other names.
profile.shimsNotOnPath: The folder of the commands is not in PATH: {{bin}}. "ot profile shims path" says how to put it there.
profile.shimsFailed: The profile is done, but its command could not be written ({{reason}}); "ot profile shims sync" tries again.
profile.shimsOff: profiles.shims.mode is "off": there are no commands by profile.
profile.shimsNoLauncher: Could not tell where ot runs from, so the commands cannot call it.
profile.shimsSynced: Commands in {{bin}}: {{written}} written, {{kept}} already right, {{removed}} removed.
profile.shimsOnPath: The folder of the commands is in PATH: {{bin}}
profile.shimsOffPath: The folder of the commands is not in PATH: {{bin}}
profile.shimsWindowsByHand: On Windows, ot does not change PATH; put the folder there by hand (see "ot profile shims path").
profile.shimsWindowsHow: To put it in PATH: Settings > System > About > Advanced system settings > Environment Variables, then add {{bin}} to the Path of your user. Open a new terminal afterwards.
profile.shimsHowNoShell:
Add this line to the rc file of your shell (or say the shell with --shell), then open a new terminal:
  {{line}}
profile.shimsNeedYes: This writes in {{file}}. Run it in a terminal to answer the question, or add --yes.
profile.shimsRc_unchanged: {{file}} already has the block; nothing changed.
profile.shimsRc_removed: Removed the block from {{file}}. A terminal that is open keeps the folder in PATH until it closes.
profile.shimsRc_absent: {{file}} has no block of ot; nothing changed.
profile.shimsReload: Open a new terminal, or run in this one: {{reload}}

executor.daemonRunning: The daemon is running on this data directory. Stop it before changing Executors (the live control of a running daemon is not built yet).
executor.noModels: The catalog of {{profile}} lists no model.
executor.draft: Fields from the catalog: model {{model}}; name {{id}}; effort {{effort}} (the model accepts: {{efforts}}); provider {{provider}}; context {{context}}; reasoning {{reasoning}}; tool calls {{tools}}.
executor.needsInput: Missing: {{fields}}. Nothing was written; give it and run the command again.
executor.dryRun: Nothing was written (--dry-run). Executor {{id}} would be registered (provider {{provider}}).
executor.local_created: profiles.{{profile}}.local written: this model runs on this machine.
executor.cost: Price in the catalog (USD per million tokens): input {{input}}, output {{output}}. It is not stored here.
executor.placed_list: Put in the list of the role {{role}} (position {{position}}).
executor.placed_preset: The preset of the role {{role}} names it: it is in the role with no change to the file.
executor.askRoles: executors.on_register is "ask": it was written only in executors. To put it in a role run again with --role <role>[:<position>]; roles: {{roles}}.
executor.removedFromRoles: Taken out of the lists of the roles: {{roles}}.
executor.rolesEmptied: These lists became empty and were taken out (the role goes back to its preset): {{roles}}.

hint.detect: Confirm which accounts take part. Only their state is read: the content of a key or a login is never read.
hint.account: Choose the registered account to bring into the roles.
hint.preset: Choose the preset: it gives the list of Executors of each role.
hint.executors: Register the Executors by API and give the spending cap of each API account (empty is valid).
hint.review: This is what will be written. Nothing is in config.yaml until you confirm.

note.catalog_unavailable: The model catalog of the account could not be read: its models are not proposed.
note.effort_not_accepted: The model does not accept the effort the preset names: it is left out.
note.legacy_executors: orchestration.executor and orchestration.roles are the old format: the lists written here take their place.
note.lists_replaced: The list of the role in the file is replaced by the list of the preset.
note.budget_suggested: API account with no cap: the suggested cap (setup.suggested_budget) is proposed.
note.no_accounts: No account takes part: the lists of the roles stay empty until one is added.
note.no_account: The preset names a model that no account of this machine has: it is left out.
note.not_registered: The list names an Executor that is not registered.
note.invalid_executor: The list has an Executor that is invalid.
note.profile_not_allowed: The Executor is left out: its account is not in roles.allowed_profiles.
note.below_minimum: The Executor is below the minimum of the role.
note.empty_list: No Executor is left in the list of the role.

setup.confirmed: Setup confirmed: {{executors}} Executor(s) registered, {{written}} key(s) written to config.yaml.
